name: Trap Case: Cheapest Option is Non-Viable
description: Cheapest alternative supplier SUP-009 quotes low price but arrives in 14 days, which is long after stock runs out on day 4. Next supplier SUP-004 costs slightly more but arrives on day 5 and is viable.
report_text: SUPPLIER DISRUPTION: Primary vendor Apex Micro Systems reports machinery breakdown delaying SKU-1042 for Chennai Plant (SITE-CHN-01) by 14 days. On-hand cover is 4 days. Need 1200 units. Severity: 4.
test_purpose: Viability filter strictly beats raw cost: cheaper option arrives too late and must be rejected.
